en.title: Greater-Than-Neighbors Stabilization
en.description:
Repeatedly filter the array simultaneously: keep the first and last elements, and the interior elements strictly greater than both their left and right neighbors; each round compares against the array as it was at the start of that round. Continue until a round makes no change, and return the final array.

Rules follow the original OAMaster problem; the input/output protocol and bounds marked "site-added" were compiled by this site.
en.input: n (1≤n≤200000), followed by n integers (absolute value ≤10^9, site-added).
en.output: Output the length of the final array and its elements.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for details.
hints: Check against the problem definition item by item, paying attention to simultaneous updates and boundary semantics.
